text:
incident-bot: PAGING: p99 latency breach detected on /v1/generate (hosted). Canary rollout 'v1.3-rollforward' is at 12% traffic. p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~3.2s, streaming stalls observed on live streams. Auto-alerting and routing control active. @tia-oncall paged :rotating_light:

tia-oncall: I’m on it. Noted canary at 12% — which regions affected?

logs-bot: samples: region-us-east p95 1180ms p99 3200ms, region-eu-west p95 980ms p99 2100ms. Error rate not elevated, but streaming chunk acknowledgements delayed.

ingrid-eng-runtime: reassigning. We started the rollforward at 1790122200; rollout window was staged -> 10% -> 25%. Looks like latency regressed at ~1790123300 when a kernel change hit for attention packing.

raj-eng-sre: tagging this as SLO:p99 breach. Paging escalation path: oncall -> eng-runtime -> eng-platform. @sam-eng-platform please prepare traffic-shift / rollback options.

sam-eng-platform: I can initiate traffic shadowing back to v1.2 and shift canary to 0%. Two options: immediate rollback (stop canary) or throttle canary to 1% and keep it running for investigation. Recommend immediate stop to protect SLOs.

mike-cs: any customer impact? CS saw two customers open support tickets (AcmeCorp, AtlasHealth) reporting streaming stalls for long-form generation. They flagged elevated latencies in logs.

eve-sre: Confirming we see increased tail latency in the long-context path. KV-cache eviction changed in v1.3 variant; suspect cache warming issue + attention kernel causing stalls for sequences >2048.

carla-product: Are rollout flags available to revert quickly? What’s risk of immediate rollback on Dedicated vs Hosted?

ingrid-eng-runtime: Hosted -> we can do a traffic reweight to previous model (v1.2). Dedicated customers pinned to dedicated pools need manual coord, but no dedicated customer rollouts were touched. Risk is low for rollback; the rollback is server-side routing only.

sam-eng-platform: Running planned mitigation: reweight canary to 0% and route all traffic to v1.2. Command below (will run now):
```bash
redwood route update --service generation --from-version v1.3-rollforward --to-version v1.2 --percent 0
```

deploy-bot: Rollout event: v1.3-rollforward -> 12% -> paused. Action: reweight command queued by sam-eng-platform.

tia-oncall: executing reweight, will monitor p95/p99 and streaming ack latencies. Notifying customer-facing teams.

(90s later)

deploy-bot: Reweight completed at 1790123620. v1.3-rollforward traffic now 0%, v1.2 at 100% for affected route.

logs-bot: post-mitigation metrics (1m window after reweight): p95 240ms -> 260ms (baseline), p99 620ms -> 650ms. Streaming ack delays cleared in sample traces.

raj-eng-sre: Good signal. Marking immediate customer impact reduced. Triage next: reproduce locally with long-context tests + KV-cache settings. @ingrid-eng-runtime + @eve-sre own root cause investigation.

ingrid-eng-runtime: initial repro shows attention kernel path with packed attention triggers an extra memcpy under specific seq_len distribution. We're bisecting build flags and diffing kernel selection logic.

eve-sre: Added a temporary regression alert rule to catch p99 > 1500ms for /v1/generate with seq_len>2048. Also capturing additional traces for canary variant.

mike-cs: I'll reach out to AcmeCorp and AtlasHealth with a status update: had a canary-induced latency spike, rollback applied, monitoring continuing.

carla-product: We should schedule a postmortem and a canary gating checklist update: include seq_len smoke tests, KV-cache warmup and kernel selection verification.

tia-oncall: handing off to night oncall @raj-eng-sre for root cause follow-up. I'll update incident channel summary and close primary paging.

raj-eng-sre: taking handoff. Next steps: reproduce in staging with traffic generator (longform load), run bisect of runtime kernel selector, coordinate with build team to revert kernel flag if needed. Will post status updates every 2h or on any change.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigation applied (traffic reweight), customer impact reduced, RCA owner assigned (ingrid-eng-runtime, eve-sre), oncall handoff to raj-eng-sre. Severity: Sev2 -> monitoring.

(End thread)
